subject: pe
title: Stretch: Designing the Perfect Plan
welcome_lead: Stretch yourself — design a programme that's safe, smart and personal.
meta_desc: GCSE PE Principles stretch: programme design, safety, rest and recovery.
final_note: Outstanding! You can design a complete training programme.

concepts.def: Time off training to allow recovery and adaptation.
Performance levels off — needs new overload.

walkthroughs.body_html: During rest, the body adapts: muscles repair, glycogen restores, the heart strengthens. Without rest, performance stalls and injury risk rises. Plan at least 1-2 rest days per week, more for very intense plans.
A plateau happens when progress stops. The fix is variation — change Frequency, Intensity, Time or Type. Mixing in new training methods can shock the body into fresh adaptation.
Run a risk assessment on facility, weather and equipment. Use a PARQ to screen new athletes. Always include a warm-up, demonstrate technique and progress load gradually. Hydrate and use correct PPE.
